mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id,m.member_level,m.status,COALESCE(a.growth,0) growth,CAST(COALESCE(a.net_spend,0.00) AS CHAR) net_spend,t.tag_id FROM (SELECT member_id,member_level,status FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id>#{after} AND created_at<=#{before} ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{limit}) m LEFT JOIN member_growth_account a ON a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.member_id=m.member_id LEFT JOIN member_tag_assignment t ON t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.member_id=m.member_id AND t.active=TRUE ORDER BY m.member_id,t.tag_id
SELECT version,effective_from,CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_growth_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effective_from<=#{at} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT version,effective_from,CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_growth_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND version>#{after} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT member_id,actor_id,display_name,member_level,status,version FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_growth_account(tenant_id,member_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id=member_id
mapper.select: SELECT growth,CAST(net_spend AS CHAR) net_spend,policy_version,version FROM member_growth_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_growth_account SET growth=#{growth},net_spend=#{net},policy_version=#{policy},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE member_record SET member_level=#{level},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,member_id,CAST(paid AS CHAR) paid,completed,policy_version,CAST(growth_rate AS CHAR) growth_rate,contribution,CAST(net_spend AS CHAR) net_spend FROM member_growth_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_growth_order SET completed=#{completed},contribution=#{contribution},net_spend=#{net} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,CAST(amount AS CHAR) amount FROM member_growth_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id}
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS CHAR) FROM member_growth_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}

SELECT sequence_id,source_id,delta,balance,policy_version,reason,created_at FROM member_growth_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND sequence_id>#{after} ORDER BY sequence_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tag_id FROM member_tag_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND active=TRUE ORDER BY tag_id LIMIT 65
SELECT tag_id,name FROM member_tag_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND tag_id=#{id}
SELECT tag_id,name FROM member_tag_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND tag_id>#{after} ORDER BY tag_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tag_id,active,version,source,reason FROM member_tag_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND tag_id=#{tag}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_tag_assignment(tenant_id,member_id,tag_id,active,version,source,reason) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member},#{input.tagId},#{input.active},1,'MANUAL',#{input.reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=#{input.active},version=version+1,reason=#{input.reason}
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id,active,version,source,reason FROM member_tag_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND tag_id>#{after} ORDER BY tag_id LIMIT #{limit}
